description: Passing the Millionaire’s Tax should be the start, not the end, of tax reform. Olympia needs to rein in spending so we’re not dependent on ever-increasing taxes to fund a budget that grows dramatically every year. And then we need to focus on replacing regressive taxes like sales, B&O, and property taxes with progressive ones,
